description: Return the wallet's unspent outputs — per UTXO: asset, amount (base units), the funding txid:vout, the holding address, block height and confirmations. Read-only: signs nothing, spends nothing, reserves nothing. Syncs before reading so the view is current (serves the last snapshot with stale:true if a provider is down).
name: wallet_list_utxos

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

utxos.description: The wallet's unspent outputs (read-only view; signs and moves nothing).

address.description: The wallet address that holds this output.

amount_sats.description: Output value in the asset's base units (sats), as a decimal string.

asset.description: Asset key (DEPIX/LBTC/USDT) or the raw Liquid asset id when unrecognized.

confirmations.description: Confirmations relative to the chain tip (0 when unconfirmed).

height.description: Block height it confirmed at, or null while unconfirmed.

txid.description: The funding transaction id of this UTXO.

vout.description: The output index within that transaction.

title: List unspent outputs (UTXOs)
